scientific_integrity: Claims are limited to proven algebraic enumeration and asymptotic law; computer enumeration provides corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Star graph with m>=1 labeled leaves only; Gumbel limit asymptotic, not a finite-size error bound. Generic assembly extreme-value theory could cover part of the asymptotic mechanism. Independent validation not undertaken.
title: Nilpotent star partial isometries: exact rank-index spectrum and a Gumbel extremal law
